label: Goodness as due actuality: DueActualityThesis f means ∀ x p, GoodIn x p ↔. GoodIn is independent…
definition: DueActualityThesis f means ∀ x p, GoodIn x p ↔ (Due f x p ∧ Has x p). GoodIn is independent, so this is a proposition that can fail, not the adopted definition of goodness.
note: Owner chose a proposition rather than adopting a definition, 2026-11-06, recorded in #1116. This is an extensional per-perfection reconstruction. It is not the unrestricted q.5 coextension of all actuality, property identity, an aggregate degree of goodness, good simpliciter, or a practical obligation. Those senses require their own explicit bridges.
